policy.decision: Person Domain v2 Review Unit 23. Resolve the final six genuinely unreviewed legacy knowledge Persons after the bounded provenance repair. Historiography, language documentation, and Indigenous cultural record belong to culture; defining Vedic religious-sage and tradition authority belongs to religion; theoretical physics, mathematics/astronomy, pathology, and antibiotic research belong to science. Science targets remain verify-only knowledge until the final atomic cutover.

review_scope.selection_rule: Review the complete six-Person unreviewed legacy knowledge remainder recorded at the Unit 22 checkpoint, using repaired canonical provenance where required. Do not leave a residual unreviewed Person; do not perform the final knowledge-to-science cutover in this unit.

entries.basis: Hrushevsky was also a major political leader during the Ukrainian Revolution, but the reviewed reference identifies him first as Ukraine's pre-eminent historian and principal organizer of Ukrainian scholarship, with a monumental historical corpus and long-term leadership in historical research. Under v2, history, historiography, and scholarship in the humanities belong to culture.

Yājñavalkya is a major philosophical figure, but the reviewed religious reference presents him as a Hindu Vedic sage associated with the White Yajur Veda, the Brihadaranyaka Upanishad, a named religious school, and enduring spiritual teaching on Brahman and the Self. Under v2, this defining sage, scripture, and faith-tradition authority places the representative domain in religion.

Tac studied for the priesthood, but his enduring representative legacy is as an Indigenous Luiseño scholar, writer, linguist, and recorder of Luiseño language, history, customs, and cultural memory. His grammar, dictionary, writing system, and historical-cultural account are foundational documentary work. Under v2, language, history, writing, and cultural memory belong to culture.

science_retained.basis: Oppenheimer's representative historical identity is theoretical physics. He made major contributions to quantum and molecular physics, trained a generation of physicists, and led the Los Alamos scientific laboratory during the Manhattan Project. Under v2, theoretical physics and formal natural-scientific inquiry belong to science; the stored value remains knowledge until final cutover.

Madhava is represented as a mathematician-astronomer of the Kerala school whose advances in infinite series and trigonometric expansions mark a decisive development toward mathematical analysis. Under v2, mathematics and astronomy belong to science; the stored value remains knowledge until final cutover.

Florey's representative identity is pathology and experimental medicine. His team systematically investigated antibacterial substances and developed penicillin into an effective chemotherapeutic treatment, work recognized by the 1945 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. Under v2, medicine, pathology, and empirical biomedical inquiry belong to science; the stored value remains knowledge until final cutover.
